scope: Literature attribution for the already predeclared gradient-quality experiment; no training recipe change.

primary_source.title: Sobolev Training for Neural Networks
primary_source.verified_claim: The paper studies training neural approximators with target derivative information in addition to function values.

inference_for_this_project: The GeoBC corner-P1 strain objective is in the broader family of value-plus-derivative supervision. Here the auxiliary targets come from signed training displacement and the fixed finite-element geometry, rather than a recovered solver tensor. Whether it improves unseen-CAD displacement/strain/stress requires this project's matched experiments.
novelty_boundary: Adding derivative supervision alone does not establish a new algorithm; current GeoBC contributions remain hypotheses about geometric/BC conditioning and reliable load-dependent continuous fields, pending demonstrated transfer benefits.
